Punjabi Jotta will always be remembered as a brave son of Punjab who stood against drugs and fought for a better future for our youth. His mission must continue, and we must stand united against drugs with peace, courage, and determination.

caption:
The entire Punjab is saddened and outraged by the murder of Arvinder Jote. It is our right to demand justice, but in these difficult times, we must restrain our anger and act wisely and responsibly.

I appeal to all the youth of Punjab not to succumb to any unlawful actions that could harm the peace of Punjab, the unity of our country, or our own people. Our strength lies in our unity, our discipline, and our restraint.

Our fight against drugs is for a noble cause. To make this fight successful, it is essential that we register our protest peacefully and democratically, within the ambit of the law. Any violence, vandalism, or illegal activity can weaken our movement and divert attention from our true purpose.

Let us all come together to demand justice for Arvinder Jote, strengthen our fight against drugs, and remain united to secure the future of Punjab.

Our aim is not revenge, but justice. Our strength is not violence, but unity. And our path is not one of illegal activities, but one of law and peace.

May Waheguru Ji empower the youth of Punjab to follow the right path and free Punjab from the stigma of drug addiction. 🙏
